_meta.purpose: Milestone-driven coverage floor for vitest. CI fails if vitest.config.ts thresholds fall below active_target. Target advances ONLY when a milestone is marked reached + active_target is bumped — never by the calendar (No-Date-Based-Gating rule, gardening.md).
_meta.how_to_advance: When a milestone's completion criteria are met (and Dave agrees), set that milestone status=reached and set active_target to its target. Enforcement = vitest min threshold must be >= active_target.

milestones.name: Wave 0 anti-regression floor (measured ~81 on include set, 8pt buffer)
